summary: Tested Owner Notifications Bug Fix - CRITICAL BUG FOUND AND FIXED. Backend: 6/6 tests passed (support login, owner login, register-device endpoint, test-push creates notification in notifications collection, owner can see test-push notification, notification has correct school_id). Frontend: Fixed critical JavaScript error 'Cannot access loadNotifications before initialization' in NotificationBell.jsx by reordering useCallback/useEffect hooks. After fix: Dashboard loads, NotificationBell works, dropdown shows 49 notifications with badge count 32.
seed_data_creation: Created test notifications via POST /api/support/schools/{school_id}/test-push during backend tests
context_for_next_testing_agent: Owner notifications bug fix fully tested. Key findings: 1) Backend test-push endpoint correctly writes to 'notifications' collection (not parent_notifications). 2) POST /api/notifications/register-device works for FCM token registration. 3) GET /api/notifications/all returns test-push notifications for owner. 4) FIXED: NotificationBell.jsx had JavaScript hoisting error - loadNotifications useCallback was defined AFTER the useEffect that used it in dependency array. Reordered hooks to fix.

bug_fixed.root_cause: useEffect at line 322-334 had loadNotifications in dependency array, but loadNotifications was defined AFTER this useEffect (at line 355). JavaScript hoisting rules caused the error.
bug_fixed.fix: Moved loadNotifications and loadAttendanceNotifs useCallback definitions BEFORE the useEffect that uses them in its dependency array.

rca_of_the_issue: The FCM foreground listener useEffect for owner/admin roles was added at line 321-334, but it referenced loadNotifications in its dependency array. Due to JavaScript's temporal dead zone for const/let declarations, the loadNotifications function (defined with useCallback at line 355) was not accessible when the useEffect was being set up. The fix was to reorder the code so that loadNotifications is defined before any useEffect that depends on it.
